subject: history_social
passage: In 1978, archaeologists in Hubei Province, China, opened the tomb of a ruler known as Marquis Yi of Zeng, who died around 433 BCE. Among the treasures inside was a set of bronze bells. The set of bells, arranged in three rows on a wooden frame, ______ sixty-five bells, each able to produce two different notes depending on where it is struck.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The subject of the verb is "set," which is singular; "of bells" and "arranged in three rows on a wooden frame" only describe the set. A singular subject needs the singular verb "includes."
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Include" is plural and would agree with "bells" or "rows," but the subject is the singular "set."
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Are including" is plural, but the subject "set" is singular.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Have included" is plural, but the subject "set" is singular.
explanation.D: Correct. The singular verb "includes" agrees with the singular subject "set."
